claims.text: In Lagos, if your tenancy agreement says you cannot challenge a rent increase, the law still allows you to apply to the Court to declare it unreasonable.
A landlord cannot eject you while your application against an unreasonable rent increase is pending in Lagos.
The Lagos Tenancy Law also says a landlord must issue a receipt for every rent payment.

post.headline: Some clauses no gree with Lagos law
lines: Ngozi, if your landlord puts for your tenancy agreement say you no fit challenge rent increase,
that clause no hold water. Lagos Tenancy Law get power pass wetin person write for paper.
You get right to go court make dem declare any increase unreasonable (lagos:increase_challenge:1).
And dem no fit pursue you commot while your case still dey pending (lagos:increase_challenge:2).
Always demand your rent receipt too (lagos:receipts:1).

short.title: Your agreement may be wrong. Lagos law overrides.
short.hook_say: Tenancy agreements in Lagos State often contain clauses that are simply not valid under the law. Don't assume everything written in your agreement can be enforced.

tips.say: If your agreement says you can't challenge a rent increase, Lagos law still lets you apply to the Court (lagos:increase_challenge:1). You have the right.
While your application against an unreasonable rent increase is pending in Lagos, your landlord cannot legally eject you (lagos:increase_challenge:2).
No matter what your agreement says, a Lagos landlord must issue a receipt for every rent payment. It's the law (lagos:receipts:1).
